'''August Meitzen''' ({{IPA|de|ˈaʊɡʊst ˈmaɪtsn̩}}; born 16 December 1822, in [[Breslau]]; died 19 January 1910, in [[Berlin]]) was a German [[statistician]].

==Biography==
He was born in Breslau (now [[Wrocław]], [[Poland]]) and educated at [[University of Heidelberg|Heidelberg]] and [[University of Tübingen|Tübingen]]. He was a prominent member of the Statistical Bureau, and in 1875 was made an associate professor of political sciences (''Staatswissenschaften'') at the [[Humboldt University of Berlin|University of Berlin]] (honorary professor from 1892).<ref>[https://www.deutsche-biographie.de/gnd116871423.html#ndbcontent Meitzen, August] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160702142923/https://www.deutsche-biographie.de/gnd116871423.html#ndbcontent |date=2016-07-02 }} In: [[Neue Deutsche Biographie]] (NDB). Band 16, Duncker & Humblot, Berlin 1990, {{ISBN|3-428-00197-4}}, S. 734 f.</ref> Between 1889 and 1891, he advised [[Max Weber]] in his completion of his post-doctoral [[Habilitation#Germany|habilitation]], a thesis that Weber titled ''[[Roman Agrarian History and Its Significance for Public and Private Law]]''.{{sfnm|1a1=Bendix|1a2=Roth|1y=1977|1pp=1–2|2a1=Kaelber|2y=2003|2p=41|3a1=Radkau|3y=2009|3p=563}}

==Works==
His contributions to the science of statistics include:
* ''Die internationale land- und forstwirtschaftliche Statistik'' ("International statistics on land and forest management"; 1873).
* ''Geschichte, Theorie und Technik der Statistik'' ("History, theory and technique of statistics"; 1886).
He also wrote:
* ''Der Boden und die landwirthschaftlichen Verhältnisse des Preussischen Staates'' ("The soil and the agricultural conditions of the Prussian state"; 8 volumes and 2 atlases, 1868–1908).
* ''Die Mitverantwortlichkeit der Gebildeten für das Wohl der arbeitenden Klassen'' (The obligation of the educated to the well-being of the working classes; 1876).
* ''Siedelung und Agrarwesen der Westgermanen und Ostgermanen, der Kelten, Römer, Finnen und Slawen'' ("Settlement and agriculture of the west and east Germans, the Celts, Romans, Finns and Slavs"; 1895).<ref>[https://de.wikisource.org/wiki/August_Meitzen August Meitzen] de.Wikisource (bibliography)</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Ashley |first=W. J. |date=1898 |title=Meitzen's Siedelung und Agrarwesen der Germanen |journal=Political Science Quarterly |volume=13 |issue=1 |pages=143–155 |doi=10.2307/2140007 |issn=0032-3195 |jstor=2140007}}</ref>
He was the author of several biographies in the ''[[Allgemeine Deutsche Biographie]]''.<ref>[https://de.wikisource.org/wiki/Kategorie:ADB:Autor:August_Meitzen Kategorie:ADB:Autor:August Meitzen] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202030105/https://de.wikisource.org/wiki/Kategorie:ADB:Autor:August_Meitzen |date=2017-02-02 }} at [[Allgemeine Deutsche Biographie]]</ref>
